# T-8: Migrate rule bodies from existing partials into rules.json with placeholders

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Move rule bodies out of partials' prose into rules.json. Partials retain non-rule prose plus the directive placeholders that point to the migrated entries.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Each of the 10 inventory rows has its body in rules.json.
- Each origin partial contains `<!-- {{data("base.skills.rule", {id: "<id>"})}} --> ... <!-- {{/data}} -->` placeholders at the location previously occupied by the rule body.
- After `sdd-forge upgrade`, deployed SKILL.md contains the rule body inline (no markers, no missing rules).

## Implementation Notes
Touched partials per inventory: ai-question-style.md, choice-format.md, core-principle.md, worktree-mode.md.

## Test Strategy
Integration test that runs upgrade against a snapshot of source partials + rules.json and asserts deployed SKILL.md contents.
